available.limits: Exact spatial bounds conditional on keeping the holder, stronger than production cache misses. Later matching may rescue an initially impossible pair. Sequential task-disjoint witnesses against the unchanged pool; same-batch assignments conservatively excluded. Not a counterfactual rollout, complete opportunity count, throughput estimate or upper bound. Reveals and later assignments would change under a new policy.

prospective_margin_audit.limits: Prospective bucket means from completed single-holder tasks before each admission. Exact BFS basis, not production cache/mixed estimates. Chronological task-disjoint safer-alternative sample on unchanged trajectories, excluding same-batch actual admissions. Not a completion probability, rollout, gain estimate, complete opportunity count or upper bound.
